description: What the catalogue offers, or why it was not read.

entries.description: Every plugin the verified index offers, by id; empty where it was not read.

failure.description: Why the index could not be read. Present where it failed.

published.description: When the index listed was published. Present where it was read.

serial.description: Which release of the catalogue the index listed is. Present where it was read.

setting.description:
The setting that keeps the catalogue from being asked, and how to let it be.
Present where it is switched off.

state.description: Whether the catalogue was read, switched off, or could not be read.

unreadable.description:
How many entries the index holds that could not be listed, for lacking a fact an
entry carries. Present where it was read.
